description: WAFv2 Web ACL has no associations in the inspected supported resource types
rationale: No resource associations were returned by complete AWS WAFv2 regional resource-type checks, or a complete CloudFront Web ACL lookup. This is an unused-ACL candidate, not proof of zero associations across unsupported/new resource types or accounts. Review before deleting to avoid service disruption.
remediation: Validate the Web ACL ARN, scope, service ownership and any out-of-scope resource integrations. Remove unused Web ACLs only after change review; associate intended resources and validate protection where needed.
